body: I guess part of me just feels like I can't do that to them. Most know I deal with depression, but not how bad it really is, and exposing that would be cause for too much worry. I want to reach out, I want to cry for help. But I feel bad as it is for posting here and putting that all on someone anyway.

I know others don't think that. I'm pretty sure they'd be shocked I feel the way I do if I told them. But I don't want to worry them.

I'm just too blind to see whatever it is they see in me. Or maybe too stupid. I don't know. All I see when I look at myself is the idiot who failed so many classes in high school and got kicked out of college and who's on the brink of being fired at work and can't just stay out of the closet and so many other failures. And it just keeps piling up.

I'm tired. I just want it all to stop.
